# E0150: a lens of the tip names a version other than the tip's parent, the newest version under history/

**Retired.** A lens names its instances prev and self, never a version, so it does not record which parent it was written against. A lens rebased onto a newer parent is compiled against that parent like any lens: a mapping that reads a field the parent does not declare is E0340, and a field of the parent the lens leaves unmapped is E0347. A lens whose mappings still fit the new parent compiles, with nothing to prompt a review of what they mean.
